question: Who among the following wrote the novel ‘Kitne Pakistan’, which won the Sahitya Akademi Award?
solution:
The correct answer is **Kamleshwar**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kamleshwar** was a renowned Indian writer in Hindi literature and a prominent figure in the Nayi Kahani movement.
 
• His novel **'Kitne Pakistan'** won the prestigious Sahitya Akademi Award in 2003.
 
• The novel explores the partition of India and its aftermath, delving into themes of division and identity.
 
• **Kamleshwar** was also a noted screenwriter and journalist, contributing significantly to Indian cinema and television.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 Category
 Description
 
 
 
 

 **Sahitya Akademi Award**
 The **Sahitya Akademi Award** is a literary honor in India, awarded annually by the Sahitya Akademi, India's National Academy of Letters.
 
 

 **Nayi Kahani Movement**
 The **Nayi Kahani Movement** was a Hindi literary movement in the 1950s-60s, emphasizing realistic and contemporary themes.
 
 

 **Partition of India**
 The **Partition of India** in 1947 led to the creation of India and Pakistan, causing massive displacement and communal violence.
